notes: Backup center: the sidebar now has Backups (local SQLite snapshots with optional encryption, retry for failed, and one-click sync to your cloud folder), Quick Items (standalone manager) and Sync Cloud Backups actions. The mobile API gained sqlite-status/enable, api-key, cashier and theme endpoints backed directly by the SQLite store, plus a backups list gateway. Encryption is now binary-safe (Buffer-based) for snapshot files, and the app plans due cloud backups hourly from the main process.
